select a.*, b.ID as idP,b.TENANT_ID as tenantIdP,b.PROJECT_ID as projectIdP,b.NAME as nameP, b.ID_CARD as idCardP,b.GENDER as genderP,b.AGE as ageP,b.PHONE as phoneP,b.HIRE_STATUS as hireStatusP, b.BELONG_COMPANY as belongCompanyP,b.WORK_TYPE as workTypeP,b.ENTER_TIME as enterTimeP,b.OUT_TIME as outTimeP, b.IS_INSURED as isInsuredP,b.INSURE_AMOUNT as insureAmountP,b.INSURE_ATTACH as insureAttachP,b.IS_SAFETY as isSafetyP, b.SAFETY_ATTACH as safetyAttachP,b.MEMO as memoP from EPC_PERSONNEL_SPECIAL a left join EPC_PERSONNEL_LEDGER b on a.PERSONNEL_ID = b.ID where a.DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE' and a.ID = #{id}
